bp_rank_foresight_control_2020_2025.classification_evidence: A control, not a closure: it demonstrates the instrument resolves a 41-point effect on 102 weeks and therefore bounds nothing at the 6-point scale the candidate arms live at.
bp_rank_foresight_control_2020_2025.description: Perfect-foresight positive control inside the served Best Pick eligibility pool, 2020-2025 opener archive
bp_rank_foresight_control_2020_2025.plain_summary: If the star always went on the game we later learned was right, it would win 97 weeks in 100 - the yardstick showing the test can see a big effect.

bp_rank_served_score_no_dispersion_vs_al.classification_evidence: No resolved wrong sign and no positive control bound; the foresight control on the same pool reads +41.18 [31.37, 50.98].
bp_rank_served_score_no_dispersion_vs_al.description: Best Pick nominee ranked by the card's own served decision score inside the 6.5-or-less spread screen alone, dispersion screen removed, against the served alpha=2000 ranker, 2020-2025 opener archive
bp_rank_served_score_no_dispersion_vs_al.notes: Companion cell to bp_rank_served_score_vs_alpha2000; separates the ranker change from the dispersion screen. 61.90% (65/105).
bp_rank_served_score_no_dispersion_vs_al.plain_summary: Dropping the book-disagreement filter and simply starring the card's most confident small-spread pick scored about the same as keeping the filter.

bp_rank_served_score_vs_alpha2000.classification_evidence: No resolved wrong sign (interval spans zero with the mass positive) and no positive control bound: the perfect-foresight control on the same pool reads +41.18 [31.37, 50.98], far above this effect, so it bounds nothing here.
bp_rank_served_score_vs_alpha2000.description: Best Pick nominee ranked by the card's own served decision score instead of the alpha=2000 candidate distance, same below-median dispersion pool and 6.5-or-less spread screen, 2020-2025 opener archive
bp_rank_served_score_vs_alpha2000.notes: Sixth reuse of the 107-week opener population for the Best Pick family; discount accordingly. Paired within week, 20000 draws, seed 20260914. A0 55.88% (57/102), A1 62.14% (64/103); nominee differs in 37 of 101 paired weeks, outcome in 16.
bp_rank_served_score_vs_alpha2000.plain_summary: Putting the star on the pick the card itself rates highest, instead of on a separate model's favourite, won about six more Best Picks per hundred weeks over 2020-2025.
